Adaptability.text: Increases the same-type attack bonus from 1.5× to 2×.

Aftermath.text: Damages the attacker for 1/4 its max HP when knocked out by a contact move.

Analytic.text: Strengthens moves to 1.3× their power when moving last.

Anger Point.text: Raises Attack to the maximum of six stages upon receiving a critical hit.

Anticipation.text: Notifies all trainers upon entering battle if an opponent has a super-effective move, Self-Destruct, Explosion, or a one-hit KO move.

Arena Trap.text: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out. Eluded by Flying-types and Pokémon in the air.

Blaze.text: Strengthens Fire moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

Clear Body.text: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.

Cloud Nine.text: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.

Competitive.text: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.

Cursed Body.text: Has a 30% chance of Disabling any move that hits the Pokémon.

Cute Charm.text: Has a 30% chance of infatuating attacking Pokémon on contact.

Damp.text: Prevents Self-Destruct, Explosion, and Aftermath from working while the Pokémon is in battle.

Defiant.text: Raises Attack two stages upon having any stat lowered.

Download.text: Raises the attack stat corresponding to the opponents' weaker defense one stage upon entering battle.

Drought.text: Summons strong sunlight that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

Dry Skin.text: Causes 1/8 max HP in damage each turn during strong sunlight, but heals for 1/8 max HP during rain. Increases damage from Fire moves to 1.25×, but absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

Early Bird.text: Makes sleep pass twice as quickly.

Effect Spore.text: Has a 30% chance of inflcting either paralysis, poison, or sleep on attacking Pokémon on contact.

Filter.text: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.

Flame Body.text: Has a 30% chance of burning attacking Pokémon on contact.

Flash Fire.text: Protects against Fire moves. Once one has been blocked, the Pokémon's own Fire moves inflict 1.5× damage until it leaves battle.

Forewarn.text: Reveals the opponents' strongest move upon entering battle.

Friend Guard.text: Decreases all direct damage taken by friendly Pokémon to 0.75×.

Frisk.text: Reveals an opponent's held item upon entering battle.

Gluttony.text: Makes the Pokémon eat any held Berry triggered by low HP below 1/2 its max HP.

Guts.text: Increases Attack to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

Harvest.text: Has a 50% chance of restoring a used Berry after each turn if the Pokémon has held no items in the meantime.

Healer.text: Has a 30% chance of curing each adjacent ally of any major status ailment after each turn.

Hustle.text: Strengthens physical moves to inflict 1.5× damage, but decreases their accuracy to 0.8×.

Hydration.text: Cures any major status ailment after each turn during rain.

Hyper Cutter.text: Prevents Attack from being lowered by other Pokémon.

Ice Body.text: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during hail. Protects against hail damage.

Infiltrator.text: Bypasses Light Screen, Reflect, and Safeguard.

Intimidate.text: Lowers opponents' Attack one stage upon entering battle.

Iron Fist.text: Strengthens punch-based moves to 1.2× their power.

Justified.text: Raises Attack one stage upon taking damage from a Dark move.

Leaf Guard.text: Protects against major status ailments during strong sunlight.

Lightning Rod.text: Redirects single-target Electric moves to this Pokémon where possible. Absorbs Electric moves, raising Special Attack one stage.

Liquid Ooze.text: Damages opponents using leeching moves for as much as they would heal.

Magic Guard.text: Protects against damage not directly caused by a move.

Magnet Pull.text: Prevents Steel opponents from fleeing or switching out.

Marvel Scale.text: Increases Defense to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

Mold Breaker.text: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent a move.

Moxie.text: Raises Attack one stage upon KOing a Pokémon.

Multiscale.text: Halves damage taken from full HP.

Natural Cure.text: Cures any major status ailment upon switching out.

Neutralizing Gas.text: Neutralizes abilities of all Pokémon in battle.

No Guard.text: Ensures all moves used by and against the Pokémon hit.

Oblivious.text: Prevents infatuation and protects against Captivate.

Overgrow.text: Strengthens Grass moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

Pickup.text: Picks up other Pokémon's used and Flung held items. May also pick up an item after battle.

Poison Point.text: Has a 30% chance of poisoning attacking Pokémon on contact.

Poison Touch.text: Has a 30% chance of poisoning target Pokémon upon contact.

Pressure.text: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokémon by one.

Quick Feet.text: Increases Speed to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

Rain Dish.text: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during rain.

Rattled.text: Raises Speed one stage upon being hit by a Dark, Ghost, or Bug move.

Reckless.text: Strengthens recoil moves to 1.2× their power.

Regenerator.text: Heals for 1/3 max HP upon switching out.

Rivalry.text: Increases damage inflicted to 1.25× against Pokémon of the same gender, but decreases damage to 0.75× against the opposite gender.

Run Away.text: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.

Sand Force.text: Strengthens Rock, Ground, and Steel moves to 1.3× their power during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.

Sand Rush.text: Doubles Speed during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.

Sand Veil.text: Increases evasion to 1.25× during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.

Scrappy.text: Lets the Pokémon's Normal and Fighting moves hit Ghost Pokémon.

Serene Grace.text: Doubles the chance of moves' extra effects occurring.

Shed Skin.text: Has a 33% chance of curing any major status ailment after each turn.

Sheer Force.text: Strengthens moves with extra effects to 1.3× their power, but prevents their extra effects.

Shield Dust.text: Protects against incoming moves' extra effects.

Skill Link.text: Extends two-to-five-hit moves and Triple Kick to their full length every time.

Sniper.text: Strengthens critical hits to inflict 3× damage rather than 2×.

Snow Cloak.text: Increases evasion to 1.25× during hail. Protects against hail damage.

Solar Power.text: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× but costs 1/8 max HP after each turn during strong sunlight.

Static.text: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing attacking Pokémon on contact.

Steadfast.text: Raises Speed one stage upon flinching.

Stench.text: Has a 10% chance of making target Pokémon flinch with each hit.

Sticky Hold.text: Prevents a held item from being removed by other Pokémon.

Sturdy.text: Prevents being KOed from full HP, leaving 1 HP instead. Protects against the one-hit KO moves regardless of HP.

Swarm.text: Strengthens Bug moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

Synchronize.text: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.

Technician.text: Strengthens moves of 60 base power or less to 1.5× their power.

Thick Fat.text: Halves damage from Fire and Ice moves.

Tinted Lens.text: Doubles damage inflicted with not-very-effective moves.

Torrent.text: Strengthens Water moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

Trace.text: Copies an opponent's ability upon entering battle.

Unaware.text: Ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for damage and accuracy calculation.

Unburden.text: Doubles Speed upon using or losing a held item.

Unnerve.text: Prevents opposing Pokémon from eating held Berries.

Volt Absorb.text: Absorbs Electric moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

Water Absorb.text: Absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

Weak Armor.text: Raises Speed and lowers Defense by one stage each upon being hit by a physical move.

Wonder Skin.text: Lowers incoming non-damaging moves' base accuracy to exactly 50%.
